items.content:
China will waive panda bond fees until the end of 2028 as part of broader efforts to spur global use of the yuan and reduce the nation’s reliance on the US dollar.
The pause on issuance and servicing charges will begin in September, China Central Depository and Clearing, the state-backed depository for the interbank bond market, said on Monday. Panda bonds are yuan-denominated securities sold in China by overseas issuers.

After conquering the sky and land, China’s robotics industry is quietly building momentum in a niche segment: high-altitude operation solutions.
